text: Done. The issue is a bug in `src/components/Toast.tsx`: all toasts share one `aria-live="polite"` region and all auto-dismiss after 5 seconds regardless of kind, so error toasts are announced politely and disappear before a slow user can read them.

input.title: Make error toasts persistent and announced assertively
input.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Error-kind toasts should render in a region with role="alert"/aria-live="assertive" (or a separate live region) instead of sharing the polite status region, and the Toast component should skip the AUTO_DISMISS_MS timeout for kind === "error" so they remain visible until the user dismisses them.
